company.name: Clearco
company.shortDescription: Clearco is an online financial platform that provides growth capital to e-commerce and B2B companies.
company.description: Clearco is an online financial platform that provides growth capital to e-commerce and B2B companies. It utilizes proprietary software and data science models to identify high-growth funding opportunities and also offers funding in exchange for a steady revenue share of earnings. It also allows startups to avail an alternative source of funding for their fast-growing businesses without diluting equity.

productsAndServices.description: Non-dilutive growth capital for U.S.-based direct-to-consumer ecommerce and SaaS businesses, supporting inventory, marketing, supplier payments, product launches, and expansion.
productsAndServices.name: Clearco Ecommerce Funding

productsAndServices.description: A replenishing funding facility that restores available capital as payments are made, supporting recurring expenses such as advertising, supplier payments, and ongoing reinvestment.
productsAndServices.name: Rolling Funding Capacity

productsAndServices.description: A one-time funding amount with an estimated payment schedule, designed for planned initiatives such as major marketing campaigns, inventory purchases, seasonal demand, and market expansion.
productsAndServices.name: Fixed Funding Capacity

productsAndServices.description: Working capital used to pay supplier invoices and eligible business receipts directly, helping ecommerce companies purchase inventory, fund production, and preserve cash reserves.
productsAndServices.name: Invoice Funding

productsAndServices.description: Capital deposited directly into a business bank account for flexible use across marketing, inventory, payroll, operations, and other growth-related expenses.
productsAndServices.name: Cash Advance

productsAndServices.description: Consultative support that helps ecommerce businesses evaluate funding structures, deployment methods, payment options, and capital strategies for growth.
productsAndServices.name: Clearco Funding Advisory and Support
